# Crew API: conversations (Public endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## GET /v1/conversations

List this grant's conversations.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `conversations:read`. |

OpenAI has no such endpoint; Crew adds it. A delegated credential lists only conversations opened under its grant.

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | no | Start after this id. |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 100, default `20`) | no |  |
| `order` | `asc`, `desc` (default `desc`) | no |  |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [ConversationList](schemas.md#conversationlist):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object` | `list` | yes |  |
| `data` | array of [Conversation](schemas.md#conversation) | yes |  |
| `first_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `last_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `has_more` | boolean | yes |  |

Errors. The response body is [Error](schemas.md#error); its `error.code` field holds the code.

| Status | Codes | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `invalid_token`, `token_revoked`, `third_party_disabled` | 401: invalid_token, token_revoked, third_party_disabled. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 403 | `entitlement_required`, `insufficient_scope`, `approval_requires_first_party`, `tool_not_registered`, `connector_definition_changed`, `use_responses_api`, `grant_paused` | 403: grant_paused, entitlement_required, insufficient_scope, approval_requires_first_party, tool_not_registered, connector_definition_changed, use_responses_api. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 429 | `rate_limited`, `concurrency_limit`, `quota_exhausted`, `notification_limited` | 429: rate_limited, concurrency_limit, quota_exhausted, notification_limited. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | 500: internal_error. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 503 | `instance_unavailable` | 503: instance_unavailable. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |

## POST /v1/conversations

Create a conversation.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |

The conversation is tagged with the grant id. The external id is conv_, never the internal session key.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

Request body fields (`application/json`), [CreateConversationRequest](schemas.md#createconversationrequest):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metadata` | [Metadata](schemas.md#metadata) | no | At most 16 pairs; keys up to 64 characters, values up to 512 (same as OpenAI). |
| `items` | array of any | no | Initial items are not accepted (they would put a conversation that never happened into history). |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [Conversation](schemas.md#conversation):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `object` | `conversation` | yes |  |
| `created_at` | [Timestamp](schemas.md#timestamp) | yes | Unix seconds. |
| `metadata` | [Metadata](schemas.md#metadata) | no | At most 16 pairs; keys up to 64 characters, values up to 512 (same as OpenAI). |
| `crew` | object | no |  |

Errors. The response body is [Error](schemas.md#error); its `error.code` field holds the code.

| Status | Codes | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request`, `unsupported_parameter`, `unsupported_tool_type` | 400: invalid_request, unsupported_parameter, unsupported_tool_type. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 401 | `invalid_token`, `token_revoked`, `third_party_disabled` | 401: invalid_token, token_revoked, third_party_disabled. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 403 | `entitlement_required`, `insufficient_scope`, `approval_requires_first_party`, `tool_not_registered`, `connector_definition_changed`, `use_responses_api`, `grant_paused` | 403: grant_paused, entitlement_required, insufficient_scope, approval_requires_first_party, tool_not_registered, connector_definition_changed, use_responses_api. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 429 | `rate_limited`, `concurrency_limit`, `quota_exhausted`, `notification_limited` | 429: rate_limited, concurrency_limit, quota_exhausted, notification_limited. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | 500: internal_error. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |

## DELETE /v1/conversations/{conversation_id}

Delete a conversation opened under this grant.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |

A delegated credential can delete only conversations opened under its grant; others get 404. 409 response_in_progress while a turn is running.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation_id` | string | yes | conv_ id |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [Deleted](schemas.md#deleted):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `object` | string | no |  |
| `deleted` | `true` | yes |  |

Errors. The response body is [Error](schemas.md#error); its `error.code` field holds the code.

| Status | Codes | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `invalid_token`, `token_revoked`, `third_party_disabled` | 401: invalid_token, token_revoked, third_party_disabled. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
